patient._comment: 'patient' is info about the patient: personal, clinical, vitals are shown on the patient card during the game; diagnosis is used for potential 'patient review' card.

clinical.quoteLong: I've been grinding ranked for like 14 hours straight and now I've got a runny nose, sore throat, and I feel gross — I was sure I was dying. No fever, breathing's fine, I just needed someone to tell me it's not serious.
clinical.presentationShort: 26yo M — 2 days of rhinorrhea, sore throat, malaise; afebrile, no respiratory distress, normal exam — viral URI.
clinical.presentationLong: 26-year-old male with two days of runny nose, sore throat, and malaise, afebrile with no respiratory distress and a normal exam — a common cold.

diagnosis.esi2roomsNotes: ESI 5: no ED treatment-area resources are expected; brief evaluation, counseling, and discharge are appropriate.
diagnosis.disposition: Discharge → supportive care (fluids, rest, analgesics), return precautions; antibiotics not indicated.
diagnosis.why: Well-appearing, afebrile URI with a normal exam → reassurance and supportive care. No antibiotics, no workup. (And maybe log off, champ.) 🎮

answer._comment: 'answer' is answer for the game scoring.

aiImageGeneration._comment: 'aiImageGeneration' is info for AI to generate the image of the patient. Most images were done with openAI gpt-image-1 using an API, not the app, in July 2026. Look for some python scripts that are used to create these images. Be sure that the anchor-image is available and is provided to the AI - otherwise the images will not be consistent.
aiImageGeneration.pose: seated, holding a tissue to his nose, a bit sheepish
signs: holding a tissue to the nose
aiImageGeneration.prompt: Softly-shaded painterly cartoon illustration in a semi-realistic Pixar/Disney style: smooth gradient shading, soft natural lighting, gentle rounded volumes, fine delicate outlines (NOT thick flat cartoon outlines), warm detailed rendering, natural realistic proportions, single character, 3/4 front view, centered, square 1:1. Match the exact painterly style, brushwork, shading, line weight, lighting, and palette of the attached reference image. Subject: a white 26-year-old man in a hoodie, seated on a blue padded clinic chair. Pose: seated, holding a tissue to his nose, looking a bit sheepish. Expression: sniffly but otherwise fine and a little embarrassed. Clearly visible: a tissue held to the nose; he otherwise looks healthy. No text, no logos.
